documents.title: GmbHG §7 — Anmeldung der Gesellschaft
documents.content: A GmbH is registered with the commercial register court in whose district the company has its registered office. Registration may only occur after the statutory capital contribution requirements in §7 have been met.

documents.title: GmbHG §8 — Inhalt der Anmeldung
documents.content: The registration application must include or attach specified documents, including the articles of association, managing director credentials where applicable, and the shareholder list. The application also contains statutory declarations and must state a domestic business address and the scope of managing directors' authority.

documents.title: AO §147 — Aufbewahrung von Unterlagen
documents.content: §147 AO requires specified tax-relevant records to be retained in an orderly manner. The current statutory text provides different periods: ten years for records listed in §147(1) no. 1 and 4a, eight years for booking documents under no. 4, and six years for other records under §147(1), subject to the statutory qualifications.
